in_arabic.name: المهاجرون
in_arabic.meaning: أولئك الذين هجروا من ديارهم وَخَوْفَ الناس منهم
in_arabic.long_meaning: أولئك الذين هجروا من ديارهم، ومن بيوتهم، ومن مَنازلهم، وَخَوْفَ الناس منهم، بسبب إيمانهم بالله ورسوله، وَالتزامهم بِأمر الله، فَكَنا نَأُمُّنَ لِلمَهاجرينَ، وَنَصِفُ لَهُم، وَنَرُزِقُهُمُ الخَيرَ، وَنَقولُ لَهُمُ، مِنَ الدنيا وَالأخِرَةِ

in_urdu.name: المهاجروں
in_urdu.meaning: وہ لوگ جو اپنے گھروں سے اور لوگوں سے خوف کے باعث چلے گئے تھے
in_urdu.long_meaning: وہ لوگ جو اپنے گھروں سے اور اپنے لوگوں سے خوف کے باعث چلے گئے تھے، ان کا ایمان اور ان کے دین سے ڈرنا تھا، کیونکہ وہ اللہ کے احکامات پر عمل کرنے والے تھے، اور وہ اللہ اور اس کے رسول پر ایمان رکھنے والے تھے، اور اللہ ان کو مہاجرین میں شمار کرتا ہے اور ان کی مدد کرتا ہے، اور اللہ ان کو جنت میں داخل کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: महाजिरून्
in_hindi.meaning: वे लोग जिन्होंने अपने घरों से और लोगों के डर के कारण चले गए थे
in_hindi.long_meaning: वे लोग जिन्होंने अपने घरों से और अपने लोगों के डर के कारण चले गए थे, उनका ईमान और उनके दीन से डरنا था, क्योंकि वे अल्लाह के आदेशों पर عمل करने वाले थे, और वे अल्लाह और उसके रसूल पर ईमान रखने वाले थे, और अल्लाह उन्हें महाजिरून में शामिल करता है और उनकी मदद करता है, और अल्लाह उन्हें जन्नत में प्रवेश कराता है

in_english.name: Mahajirun
in_english.meaning: Those who left their homes and the fear of people because of their faith in Allah and His Messenger
in_english.long_meaning: Those who left their homes and the fear of people because of their faith in Allah and His Messenger, due to their adherence to the commandments of Allah and their faith in the Hereafter, and because they preferred to be with Allah and His Messenger, Allah counts them among the Muhajirun, and He helps them, and Allah grants them the good of this life and the Hereafter

data.cultural_impact: The name Mahajirun in Islamic culture is associated with the historic event of the emigration of Prophet Muhammad and his companions from Mecca to Medina, known as the Hijra. This event marked the beginning of the Islamic calendar and the establishment of the Islamic state in Medina. The term Mahajirun can be used to refer to individuals who migrate in search of knowledge, religious experience, or to seek refuge and security. It is a term of pride and honor in the Islamic tradition, and is often used to describe the devoted followers of the Prophet, who left their homes and possessions behind to spread the message of Islam and establish the first Muslim communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mahajirun is a reminder of the willingness and eagerness to leave behind comfort and familiarity in order to seek a deeper connection with Allah (God). It is a symbol of the desire for self-improvement, spiritual growth, and to serve Allah and His creation in the best possible way. The name evokes the idea of being a traveler on the spiritual journey of life, always striving towards greater understanding and closeness to Allah. It is a reflection of the Islamic principle of constant migration from ignorance to knowledge, from sin to righteousness, and from worldliness to God-consciousness. By embracing the name Mahajirun, one affirms their commitment to the spiritual path and the journey towards self-improvement and ultimate union with Allah.

modern_usage.modern_context: The term 'Mahajirun' originated from the early Islamic history, referring to the emigrants from Mecca to Medina during the time of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Today, this term is used in a modern context to describe Muslim migrants and their communities around the world. On platforms such as Twitter, Facebook, and WhatsApp, Mahajirun is used to discuss topics related to Islamic history, migration experiences, and community building among Muslim diasporas. Hashtags like #Mahajirun and #MuslimMigration are commonly used on Twitter to share personal stories, news articles, and academic research on the topic. Facebook groups like 'Mahajirun Global' and 'Mahajirun Canada' provide a space for Mahajirun communities to connect, share resources, and offer support to new immigrants. WhatsApp groups are also popular for communication and information sharing within Mahajirun communities, particularly in countries with large Muslim populations.

name_in_real_life.story: Fatima Mahajirun, a teacher in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, shares that their name Mahajirun meaning "Traveler" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Mahajirun in Arabic means "the emigrants" or "the emigrated". This name is a reminder of the migration of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions from Mecca to Medina, marking a significant event in Islamic history and the foundation of the Islamic community. It symbolizes the spirit of sacrifice, perseverance, and dedication to faith and community.
